cesnet.target: log1p(n_bytes), as stored in the npz

primary.rule: CENTILE protocol: fully valid windows in [cut, T), stride 24, rng(0).choice(pool, 3000)

recent.rule: last 672 bins (28 days), fully valid windows, stride 24, rng(1).choice(pool, 3000). My addition, not in CENTILE

calibration.rule: fully valid windows inside [cut-672, cut), stride 24, rng(2).choice(pool, 3000). My addition; used only for split conformal

fdata.rule: CENTILE loader: sort by submit time, drop rows with missing submit/runtime/limit, limit=max(limit, runtime), runtime>=1 s; window starts 7 days after first job and lasts 14 days; history = every earlier job in the file

jid_is_not_a_row_key.note: the replay treats each row as one job and keeps all duplicates, as CENTILE does, so rows are keyed by parquet_row. I have not established why a jid repeats

fdata.sort_note: sort_values('adt') is not a stable sort; replay_order in fdata_replay_jobs.csv freezes the tie order that produced the published numbers
